title: Lawrence NDE 6031
content: The tunnel was green or light yellow. It was Palm Sunday. I had to go through palm leaves that I had to go through. This was slowly opening from a bigger opening entrance that was gently or slowly peeled open. There was a spiral tunnel getting narrower toward the end. The first spirit to greet me was a Jewish co-worker, married to a Catholic wife, who had just passed a few months ago. Then I was looking for my parents and grandparents and was able to communicate with them briefly. I saw the spirit of my roommate in the hospital next to me who was dying. He was physically gurgling with secretions on a do not resuscitate list. There was no gender or religion out there. The communication with the afterworld, people whom had passed, is all in spirit; no faces but I knew they were communicating with me. I communicate with them while moving along an immense background of dark space. All of a sudden, I was pulled back into a tunnel of very bright light, almost sunny in character; with a lot of floaters (rocks and other debris) on the way back into my body. I felt very peaceful and pleasant, physically smiling afterwards. I thanked God for the experience.

tunnel.movement_other_detail: Had to go through palm leaves that slowly opened/peeled open; spiral tunnel getting narrower toward the end.

arrival.other_being_detail: First spirit to greet experiencer was a deceased Jewish co-worker; later communicated briefly with parents and grandparents; also saw the spirit of a hospital roommate who was dying.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Palm leaves opening/peeling within a green/light-yellow spiral tunnel; 'floaters (rocks and other debris)' during return through very bright light tunnel; noted 'There was no gender or religion out there.'
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Tunnel with palm leaves/spiral narrowing; greeted by deceased co-worker; brief communication with parents/grandparents; saw spirit of dying hospital roommate; moving along immense dark space; then pulled back into a very bright-light tunnel with debris back into body.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Tunnel described as green or light yellow with palm leaves (Palm Sunday) that opened/peeled back; return through bright light tunnel with 'floaters (rocks and other debris)'; communication described as spirit-to-spirit with no faces but knowing who was communicating; statement that there was 'no gender or religion out there.'
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “The tunnel was green or light yellow.” “There was a spiral tunnel getting narrower toward the end.” “I communicate with them while moving along an immense background of dark space.” “All of a sudden, I was pulled back into a tunnel of very bright light, almost sunny in character; with a lot of floaters (rocks and other debris) on the way back into my body.” “There was no gender or religion out there.”
